# `dashboard/views/tasks.ts`

Module overview for the task view layer. Provides HTML rendering helpers for every part of the task dashboard UI — list pages, detail panels, enrichment accordions, scoring badges, activity feeds, blueprint sections, preview rows, and debug panels. All user-supplied content is HTML-escaped before rendering to prevent XSS. Only a small subset of functions are exported as named exports; the remainder are internal helpers documented here for completeness.

---

### `renderMarkdown`

> Internal — import via `import { renderMarkdown } from '...'`

Renders a markdown string to HTML with table support and XSS protection. All cell content is escaped before processing to prevent injection.

Supported syntax:

| Feature | Syntax |
|---|---|
| Bold | `**text**` or `__text__` |
| Italic | `*text*` or `_text_` |
| Horizontal rule | `---`, `***`, or `___` |
| Tables | GFM-style pipe tables |
| Paragraphs & line breaks | Standard blank-line separation |
| Inline code | `` `code` `` |
| Code blocks | ` ``` ` fenced blocks |
| Links | `[text](url)` with URL validation |
| Lists | `- item` or `* item` |
| Headings | `# Heading` |

**Signature**

```ts
renderMarkdown(markdown: string): string
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `markdown` | `string` | Raw markdown string to render. |

**Returns:** `string` — Sanitized HTML string.

---

|---|---|---|

### `renderTable`

> Internal — import via `import { renderTable } from '...'`

Renders a GFM-style table from an array of pipe-delimited lines. Table cells are escaped before markdown processing to prevent injection. Validates that the table structure is sound before rendering.

**Signature**

```ts
renderTable(lines: string[]): string
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `lines` | `string[]` | Lines of raw text forming a pipe-delimited table. |

**Returns:** `string` — An HTML `<table>` string, or an empty string if the structure is invalid.
